data.description: 【杏山和纱 · 泳池边西瓜】清凉的度假泳池边，和纱蹲在冰镇大西瓜旁，黑发扎成可爱的小团子，猫耳随着动作一颤一颤。她握着塑料小刀认真比划着分割线，粉瞳满是专注——「老师快看，这个西瓜绝对超甜！我把最中间最甜的那一块切给你，作为交换……今天的防晒油你要负责帮我涂完全身哦。」
data.promptProse: Kazusa crouches beside a chilled watermelon by the resort pool, carefully marking where to divide it with a small plastic knife. Her black swimsuit and cat-ear swim hood with red ribbon remain clear in the slightly low medium view. Pool tiles extend behind the fruit and water lies farther back. Summer sunlight reveals the rind stripes and her focused hands, with compact contact shadows beneath the watermelon.
data.title: 杏山和纱 · 泳池边切西瓜的认真瞬间
